question: In the bubbling fluidized bed, by what percentage did the measured NO emissions rise when the NH3 co-firing ratio went from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0?
rendered:
Document 10: "Carbon-Free Ammonia Co-firing in Fluidized Bed Combustion: Analysis of Advanced Chemical Modeling and Detailed Mechanism"

Page 7: "During the experiment, when the PA/SA ratio was 1, NOx emissions were 170 ppm, and NO tended to decrease as the PA/SA ratio decreased."

Page 10: "The experimental results indicated that NO emissions increased significantly from 169 to 308 ppm as RNH3 increased from 0 to 10% under a PA/SA ratio of 1:0."

The percentage rise in NO emissions is calculated as ((308 - 169) / 169) * 100 = 82.2%
